description: Every pool of points a battle tracks. `unit` scope gives each frame its own balance; `faction` scope gives a whole side one shared balance, which is what Command Points are. Availability is separate from balance, so a link-gated pool keeps its points while the link is down.

burst.name: Burst
burst.description: Stored manoeuvring power. Spent on hard turns during a route, or on extending a close-range impact sequence. Banked between activations, so a quiet turn buys a loud one.

capacitor.name: Capacitor
capacitor.description: Stored charge. Ordinary weapon fire trickles it in and a dedicated grounding cycle floods it, but the discharge that matters spends most of the bank at once. A full capacitor is a threat to a whole formation; an empty one is a frame standing too far forward with a sidearm.

commandPoints.name: Command Points
commandPoints.description: The squad's coordination budget. Reactions and coordinated actions draw on it; an ordinary activation never does, so running dry costs you options, not turns.

ordnance.name: Ordnance
ordnance.description: Devices on hand. Placing one spends it; firing the launcher scavenges another. A preparation operator who has emptied her rack is a mediocre rifleman standing in a place she chose for other reasons.

reactionCapacity.name: Reaction capacity
reactionCapacity.description: How many times one frame can respond out of turn before its own next activation. Universal: every unit has it whether or not anything it owns reacts.

sectionSevenTempo.name: Section Seven tempo
sectionSevenTempo.description: The trio's shared conversion budget, available only while their combat link holds. A continuous timeline has no rounds, so it refills a point whenever one of them acts.
